releaseNotes: 2.4.1: works in applications published with trimming or NativeAOT: serialization with metadata generated at build time, IsAotCompatible. 2.4.0: AddChromaClient and AddKeyedChromaClient register one ChromaClient singleton per key, whose HttpClient takes the current handler of IHttpClientFactory at each request; ChromaClient.WithMetadataValues and ChromaClient.Options; what a client learns about the server is asked again after two minutes. 2.3.0: the v1 API for the older servers (WithApiVersion(ChromaApiVersion.V1)); URIs of the records; ChromaQuery with Ids; exact metadata values (WithMetadataValues(ChromaMetadataValues.Exact)), lists in metadata and ChromaWhereOperator.Contains and NotContains; ListCollections by pages, GetCollectionById, CollectionExists, the space of a collection (ChromaCollectionDefinition, ChromaCollection.Space), ChromaClient.GetCollectionClient; ListDatabases and DeleteDatabase; GetUserIdentity and GetPreFlightChecks; writes in batches (WithBatchSplitting); ChromaException.StatusCode; AddKeyedChromaClient; filters print their JSON. In and NotIn without values throw an ArgumentException. Fixed: empty tenant or database means the default, answers of the older servers, messages of a bare 404 or 405, the license in the packages. Tested versions: https://github.com/ChromaDotNet/ChromaDB.Client/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md. 2.2.0: the token can be sent in Authorization: Bearer (WithChromaToken(token, ChromaTokenTransportHeader.Authorization)), and basic authentication is supported (WithBasicAuth); the With* methods keep all the other options. 2.1.0: ChromaClient creates and gets tenants and databases (CreateTenant, GetTenant, CreateDatabase, GetDatabase); the CI also runs all the tests in a non-default tenant and database. 2.0.1: the configuration URI works without the trailing slash, and with just the address of the server, like http://localhost:8000; the packages credit their authors; the CI also tests Chroma 0.5.16. 2.0.0: uses the Chroma v2 API, so the configuration URI ends with /api/v2/. Other breaking changes: ChromaCollectionQueryEntry.Distance is float?, null when the query does not include distances; every async method takes an optional CancellationToken as its last parameter. Fixed: Modify, AddChromaClient, the request URLs of the netstandard2.0 build, the error messages, and the HttpClient passed to the clients is no longer modified. Migration: https://github.com/ChromaDotNet/ChromaDB.Client#migrating-from-chromadbclient-1x
